test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/881c04a78cf77dc6f149592db0a1d3dc05a2edbd7335bd74186987c5609d523e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The arrow skips two places in the next boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f540efea3e8b812e6260ea5f359f24a07df1e5eca6fee855b70f5b210f7b2e7c.png] 

Step II: The symbol skips two places in the next boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa8c8b213bd2fab4d67ce5cc9c3b679b792fc29558caaeb99da63235779722fe.png] 

Step III: A new alphabet is added to each box.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cde721ecf726fb625849fe1e5dec1024f03bdab2ab48f7f24cf268489a1dc14a.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d0157bd6214d6fb9db79ee1a38c75a5d06751efb006a688b6076b67b1f0153a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
